Here in the tangled rainforest at Mary’s Creek in Queensland is the macadamia’s main ancestral home. Ian McConachie has always been partial to a macadamia nut. As a boy in Brisbane in the 1940s he used to climb fences to steal them from people’s backyards. “We’d put them in a little hole in the concrete under the house and hit them with a hammer.” Continue reading...
